question: Is the engine's right tail a REPEATABLE property, or was the 2026-07-29..2026-08-27 cluster a single favourable regime?
why_it_matters: Engine-era book is +$349 (all arms, 419 trips, 47 days) / +$1,121 (active 4, 300 trips, 44 days).
Removing the single best day makes BOTH scopes NEGATIVE (-$3,275 / -$1,698).
All 5 tail days (> +$500) fall inside one 6-week stretch; June and September produced none.
At n=44 trading days, 'fat tail firing ~monthly' and 'one lucky regime' fit the data equally well.

The go-live gate is RED because CI-lower <= 1.0 -- which is the CORRECT reading of exactly this ambiguity. Only additional independent days can resolve it; parameter tuning on 44 days where 5 carry the result is overfitting by construction (C4).

population.explicitly_excluded: journal/trades.csv is NOT a valid source -- it spans the pre-engine era (2026-04-29..2026-06-26) and inflates any engine claim with J-era manual fills (lesson 2026-09-10).
population.arms_scope: BOTH reported: all-arms and active-4 (safe-2, bold-2, safe-3, risky-1). Retired arms (safe-1, risky-3) excluded from the active-4 scope.
population.unit: TRADING DAY. Tail-day counting is day-level and therefore immune to the arm-replication trap; the wave-dedupe note below applies to the diagnostic breakdown only.
population.wave_dedupe_note: Per-arm agreement on one signal is REPLICATION, not independent confirmation (lesson 2026-09-10): the 08-04 best day is 2 market events taken by 4-7 arms. Any per-wave diagnostic in the scorer must dedupe on a ~10-minute bucket + contract symbol.

observation_window.rationale: Starts the trading day AFTER this prereg was frozen, so no observed data informed the threshold. Ends at the governing config-freeze clock.

hypothesis_H1_tail_is_real.claim: The tail fires at approximately the August rate (5 tail days per 20 trading days = 0.25/day).

hypothesis_H0_regime_cluster.claim: The Jul-Aug cluster was regime-specific and the tail does not generalise.

decision_rule.primary_metric: count of trading days in the observation window with all-arms engine-attributed book P&L > +500 USD
decision_rule.H1_SUPPORTED: >= 4 tail days -- the tail is repeatable; continue accumulating n toward the gate.
decision_rule.AMBIGUOUS: 2 or 3 tail days -- still undersampled; extend the window, do NOT tune.
decision_rule.H0_SUPPORTED: <= 1 tail day -- the regime-cluster hypothesis wins decisively; a KILL conversation on the current signal is warranted at the 10-30 checkpoint.
decision_rule.no_peeking_clause: The threshold above is frozen. It may NOT be revised after observing the window; any revision requires an explicit amendment entry recording what was already seen (which invalidates the pre-registration).

secondary_diagnostics_non_decisional: mean/median trip exit multiple (baseline: 0.98x / 0.86x of premium paid)
per-month tail-day counts, to see whether any recurrence is itself clustered
kill_criteria_for_this_prereg: If fewer than 10 trading days with engine fills accrue in the window, the test is UNDERPOWERED and returns no verdict rather than a weak one.
revert: git revert the commit that added the tracker; this prereg is measurement-only and touches no trading-path file.
freeze_note: Measurement only. Nothing in this prereg proposes or authorises a config change. CONFIG FREEZE 2026-08-31 -> 2026-10-30 is unaffected.
